description: Returns the full Hebrew and English text of one canonical ref, or of up to 10 refs, with links. A range such as 'Shabbat 21b:5-11' works. Text is cut at about 3000 characters per language for one ref (1500 when several are read) and marked [TRUNCATED].

ref.description: Canonical ref, e.g. 'Genesis 1:1' or 'Shulchan Arukh, Orach Chayim 75:1'.

refs.description: Several canonical refs to read in one call (max 10). Use instead of `ref`.

name: fetch_text
title: Read Bereishes texts
